title: Hovering a search result shows quick-action buttons
permissions_required: Any signed-in user of the ShopView App. Whether search results are scoped by role is to confirm — pending Branko's PRD.
preconditions: 1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. Some sample work orders, customers, assets, parts and vendors exist.
steps: 1. Open the page search panel (recent items or results shown).
2. Move the mouse over a result row.
3. Look at the right side of that row.
expected: 1. Quick-action buttons appear on the row, depending on the result type — for example 'Add new line' on a work order, 'New work order' on an asset or customer, 'Add part' on a part sale, 'Add contact' on a vendor and 'Add to work order' on a part.
2. Behaviour to confirm — pending Branko's product write-up; to be checked live once the feature is available. (exactly which quick actions show for which result type, and what each one does).
notes: Design-only (hover quick-actions). Which action shows per type + behaviour pending confirmation.
